title: The five qcore-provider-* crates cannot join the contract load path (QI017), so eight provider-owned wrappers keep restating libc contracts; the naming decision is the user's
why: Card CONTRACT-INHERIT-ADOPTION wired the real load path (providers/contract-load-path.json from Cargo metadata, NAMESPACE/PUBLISHED constants, schema-2 manifest references, package include pins) for the six quirin-provider-* crates only. Its census (docs/reports/contract-inherit-adoption/census.json) finds 11 custody-bearing provider declarations whose clauses equal a libc contract under positional renaming, 9 of them in qcore-provider-* crates the derivation rule refuses: rd_malloc, rd_calloc, rd_strdup, rd_strndup, rd_free (librdkafka/memory.qcore; rd.h forwards to malloc/calloc/strdup/strndup/free with rd_assert), mk_mem_alloc, mk_mem_alloc_z, mk_mem_free (monkey/memory.qcore; mk_memory.h forwards to malloc/calloc(1,n)/free) and cJSON_Delete (not a wrapper: a recursive delete; stays written out). The card did not rename crates or change the rule. Options, each with its cost, are in the report's naming section: (A) rename the five to quirin-provider-* (113 tracked files / 233 occurrences outside docs/reports and docs/plans at base dfe10c92; 51 files in 27 frozen report directories keep the old paths; archived contract-path keys under providers/qcore-provider-* change spelling; plugin ids qcore.* can stay, but the executables are named after their crates, so package digests are expected to move, not measured); (B) widen the derivation to a second fixed prefix qcore-provider-NAME -> NAME (derive_contract_namespace, Lean deriveNamespace, C15/QI017 text, a NAMESPACE/PUBLISHED record for bin crates, e.g. [package.metadata.quirin], and a Cargo edge qcore-provider-{librdkafka,libevent} -> quirin-provider-libc); (C) an explicitly recorded namespace accepted without derivation (weakest: a reader can no longer derive the qualifier from the package name). Recommendation recorded: (B). Until decided, package include pins are exercised by synthetic packages only (providers/tests/test_contract_load_path.py, crates/qcore-contract/tests/contract_bundle_includes.rs): no real package can include. Discharge: a recorded user decision; if (A) or (B), convert the eight wrappers with the same parity test and arbiter attribution this card used, and build and verify a real package with include pins.

title: flb_strdup/flb_strndup contracts are trusted assumptions over static inline header bodies the analyzer could read, and the pinned corpus has no call site that exercises them
why: Card CONTRACT-INHERIT-ADOPTION declared, at the user's direction, fluent_bit/resource_string.qcore: flb_strdup and flb_strndup inherit libc::strdup and libc::strndup, and the module is selected in cycle19-resource-contracts.json. Both are static inline in include/fluent-bit/flb_str.h, so wherever the module is selected the contract stands in for a body the unit carries. flb_strndup is not a byte-exact forward of strndup (memcpy of exactly n bytes through flb_malloc); only the custody statement is the same. Measured: of the 185 pinned units exactly one (flb_input_chunk.c) includes flb_str.h, it calls neither function outside the header's own inline bodies, and the arbiter moved no byte of the verdict-bearing diagnostics (class c: 0 leaves). The declared-ABI gate agrees in that unit. The assumption therefore has no measured effect yet and no measured evidence either. Discharge: when the corpus scope reaches units that call flb_strdup/flb_strndup, attribute the arbiter delta leaf by leaf and decide, with W4 summaries of the header bodies as the comparison, whether to keep the contract selected or let the analyzer check the bodies (the W43-LIBC-HEADER-INLINE-BODIES precedent for glibc inline bodies).

title: Inheriting a parent whose result is resource_return_alias(p, n) / resource_return_interior(p, n) is analysed but not exercised
why: W43-LIBC-RESULT-ALIAS (merged on main after this card's base dfe10c92) adds two v1 result predicates whose first argument is a parameter name. Card CONTRACT-INHERIT-ADOPTION could not test them on its base. By construction the positional renaming (rename_clauses) replaces every parent-parameter word in every clause, the capture check refuses a child parameter that occurs as any other word, and the v1 agreement gate requires the loaded child record to equal the parent's, the same path the realloc fixture (resource_return_reallocated(ptr, nullable), index-bearing) already exercises. The answer is exact only if the new modes load the aliased parameter by index; if a mode retained a name, every renamed child would be refused (QI012, fail-closed). Discharge: on the combined tree, a load-path test that inherits a resource_return_alias parent and a resource_return_interior parent with renamed parameters and asserts equal loaded records, plus a capture control on the second argument; or a recorded refusal.
